args.rationale: The recommendation to buy 800 units is rejected. Purchasing 800 units costs $12,000.00 from SUP-A ($14,000.00 from SUP-B), which is infeasible because it exceeds the available budget of $10,000.00. Additionally, the shortage is not a volume deficit over the planning horizon but a 4-day timing gap. Current usable inventory of 1,000 units covers daily demand of 100 units/day through 2026-09-26, resulting in a stockout of 400 units between 2026-09-27 and 2026-09-30 before PO-505 arrives on 2026-10-01. Expediting existing order PO-505 (2,000 units) by 4 days to arrive on 2026-09-27 costs $450.00, is budget-feasible, and completely eliminates the 400 units of unmet demand.
